name: Calendar: Add Imported Feed

description.en: Add a public iCalendar feed that imports events into this team's JoAi updates. Set the source timezone, choose whether incoming events publish automatically, and provide only public properties that websites may display.
description.de: Fügt eine öffentliche iCalendar-Quelle hinzu, die Ereignisse in die JoAi-Updates dieses Teams importiert. Lege die Zeitzone fest, entscheide über automatische Veröffentlichung und übergib nur öffentliche Felder für Websites.

bot: Use this when the user wants JoAi to regularly import events from a public .ics or webcal source. Confirm the source URL and timezone first; never place private contact data in properties.

inputs.name: Name

description.en: A clear name for this calendar source
description.de: Ein eindeutiger Name für diese Kalenderquelle

inputs.bot: A short descriptive source name, for example 'ÖFB fixtures' or 'Community events'.

inputs.name: Source URL
inputs.bot: A publicly reachable HTTPS or webcal iCalendar URL. Do not use a private or authenticated URL.

inputs.name: Timezone

description.en: IANA timezone used by the source

inputs.bot: The source's IANA timezone, for example Europe/Vienna. Ask when the source does not make it clear.

inputs.name: Publish automatically
inputs.bot: True only if incoming events should become publicly visible immediately; otherwise they remain drafts for review.

inputs.name: Public properties

description.en: Optional public key-value properties attached to every imported event
description.de: Optionale öffentliche Schlüssel-Wert-Felder für jedes importierte Ereignis

inputs.bot: Optional JSON object of safe public string values, for example {"section":"fussball","source":"oefb"}. Never include personal or private data.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug that will own this calendar source
description.de: Team-Slug, dem diese Kalenderquelle gehören soll

inputs.bot: The slug of the team that should own this calendar source. Omit it to use the current team.
